name: Carolyne
source:
Carolyne is a nurse who's been known to take jobs for [spoiler]Fred[/spoiler]. She doesn't ask questions and doesn't want to answer any either. She's mysterious and keeps both her past and the circumstances she met [spoiler]Fred[/spoiler] under a secret.

Carolyne seems to be a trustworthy person, willing to help the main character with his daddy issues. She's charming and confident, seeming to honestly care about the main character's well-being.

[In-game description]
